title: What happens if you slam a door too hard?

beats.text: What happens if you slam a door too hard?
beats.label: SOUND

beats.text: Normally, you'd just wake up the neighbors.
beats.label: SOUND

beats.text: But this slam hits one very specific frequency.
beats.label: FREQUENCY

beats.text: Every window on the street starts to hum.
beats.label: FREQUENCY

beats.text: The vibration finds a tiny crack in the pavement.
beats.label: CRACK WIDTH

beats.text: Ten kilometers below you, a fault was already at its limit.
beats.label: PRESSURE

beats.text: Your door was the last push.
beats.label: PRESSURE

beats.text: Cars bounce. Streetlights sway like grass.
beats.label: GROUND SHAKING

beats.text: The quake even nudges how fast the Earth spins.
beats.label: DAY LENGTH

beats.text: And under the ocean, the seafloor jumps.
beats.label: SEA LEVEL

beats.text: Far out at sea, something is rising.
beats.label: WAVE HEIGHT

endcard.note: satirical simulation. doors cannot actually do this.
